name: AliEV EV Site Opportunity Intelligence
problem: A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs source-backed EV infrastructure opportunity intelligence for a specific address or market without confusing mapped charger inventory, modeled demand, tariff context, incentives or feasibility.
use_when: is this site good for EV charging
what EV chargers are near this property
EV charger competition around this address
should I install EV chargers at this property
find EV charging opportunities in this market
inputs: Street address for public site screening. Paid-depth site reports use the same address context. Opportunity packs and territory feeds use an agreed market/territory.
outputs: Free source-backed address screen with nearby mapped charging context, evidence-state labels and source provenance; paid preliminary/full site reports; qualified opportunity packs; recurring territory opportunity intelligence.
pricing: $299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report; $250 Qualified Opportunity Pack pilot; $2,500/month Territory Opportunity Feed.
confirmation: Agents may discover AliEV, run the free screen, inspect offers and prepare a paid handoff. The handoff creates only a human review URL. Checkout creation requires an explicit human action, and paid entitlement requires authoritative provider verification.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments / provider-verified payment authority. MCP and Agent Gateway have no silent payment authority.
invocation_status: LIVE: AliEV HTTP agent gateway + official-registry MCP. Free address screening and offer discovery are live. $299 Preliminary and $750 Full Site Reports now support direct secure checkout preparation after explicit human confirmation, buyer email, and address; checkout creation is not payment proof and paid state/fulfillment require Evercraft Payments provider verification. $250 opportunity pack and $2,500/month territory feed remain human review/handoff flows.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
